offering_description.value: Provides in-home healthcare to medically complex patients, mainly children but also adults and seniors. Services include private duty nursing, home health nursing and therapy, hospice, and medical solutions such as enteral nutrition supplies. Delivered by its own clinicians in patients' homes, paid mostly by government programs.

primary_products.value: enteral nutrition and medical supplies; durable medical equipment

primary_services.value: private duty nursing; home health nursing and therapy; hospice care; pediatric therapy; care management

customer_segment.value: B2C: medically complex children, adults and seniors receiving care at home; B2G: Medicaid and Medicare programs and state agencies funding care; B2B: commercial insurers and managed care organizations

end_markets.value: home healthcare; pediatric care; hospice and palliative care; medical supplies

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicaid, Medicare and commercial insurer payments for nursing, therapy, hospice and supplies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs nurses and therapists delivering in-home care to patients paid by government and insurers; distributor: buys enteral and medical supplies and delivers them to patients

geography_served.value: US national: Operates in many US states across the country

specialization.value: related lines: private duty nursing, home health and hospice, and medical solutions, all in-home care

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branch offices dispatching clinicians to patient homes; other: referrals from physicians, hospitals and payers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare and Medicaid participation, state licensure and certification of home health and hospice, CMS, state health departments
